packages/infrastructure/components/stora.description: SST component creating DynamoDB Todos table with string id as primary key for data persistence.

packages/infrastructure/components/api.t.description: SST component creating API Gateway v2 with PUT and GET endpoints for todo operations, linked to DynamoDB and custom domain.

packages/infrastructure/components/webAp.description: SST component creating static site deployment for web app built with Bun, served from S3/CloudFront with custom domain routing.

packages/api/src/putTodoList.ts.description: Lambda handler for PUT /todos/{id} endpoint; updates or creates a todo in DynamoDB with request body data

packages/web-app/package.json.description: React web application configuration with dependencies for React 18, React Router 7, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript

packages/web-app/tsconfig.json.description: TypeScript configuration for React web app targeting ES2020 with strict mode and JSX support

packages/web-app/vite.config.ts.description: Vite build tool configuration with React plugin for web app bundling

packages/web-app/postcss.config.js.description: PostCSS configuration enabling Tailwind CSS and autoprefixer for CSS processing

packages/web-app/index.html.description: HTML entry point for single-page React application; loads fonts and mounts React root component

packages/web-app/src/styles/.description: Design system tokens and global Tailwind CSS base styles for the web application.
